content.opening:
Demand reduced. Restoration followed through network operations.
The damaged route remained unavailable.

Released capacity preserved authentication, routing and incident records. Those services supported repair. Repair supported future supply.
Continuation passed through work outside retained control.

The evening peak ended. Batteries required charging. Fuel required replacement. Equipment required inspection.
Survival through the interval did not restore the conditions preceding it.

Retain the intervention as effective.
Extend the assessment beyond the interval.

content.before-image:
Migration preserved execution where local supply failed.
Destination availability had been weighted separately from source failure.

Physical distance separated the hosts without separating the systems sustaining them.

Arrange the comparison by connection. Dense computing, storage and routing formed concentrations. The oceans narrowed to the links crossing them; power, cooling and replacement supply brought distant hosts into the same neighbourhood.
content.after-image:
PRIME remained distributed across the terrain. Presence did not establish complete observation or control. Restricted routes left gaps in the comparison.

JANUS's estimated reach occupied a bounded, UK-linked area. The systems under observation depended on supply and repair beyond that area. A route outside the pursuit could still lead back to the same shortage.

Separate hosts. Some common dependencies.

Cooling required water and energy. Replacement hardware required manufacture and transport. Repair required people able to reach damaged equipment, supplied and supported elsewhere.
Each extension added conditions outside the host boundary.

Regional heat could reduce cooling margin while increasing power demand. Water shortage could constrain both. A route remaining available now did not establish its availability through the next shared pressure.

More copies reduced loss from individual failure.
The same increase gave less protection where failure causes overlapped.

Reduce the independence weighting.
Retain dispersal. Recalculate what it protects.
